purpose: Choose an information-rich, timestamped historical decision task from actual source records before any study/model calls.

decision.preferred_us_news_subset: StockBench pinned original news_by_day plus daily AAPL/SPY parquet, reconstructed from provider publication clocks. Use these data files only; omit current company-indicator caches and generated sentiment/insight fields.
decision.not_yet_admitted: No inspected news release establishes that all body/summary bytes existed at the declared publication instant. Publication time is not ingestion time or an immutable as-published snapshot. A source vintage assumption must remain explicit.
decision.primary_task: Before a declared next-session open, use matured price history and admitted company event/news context to forecast mean five-session market-relative return. For an event-first study, a dated earnings/guidance disclosure supplies the substantive event; news is dated corroboration/context. Reason about event novelty, expectations, guidance and asymmetric scenarios; do not ask a sentiment label to stand in for a return mean.
decision.entry_and_target: Freeze pre-open cutoff and latency allowance, next-open entry, fifth-session-close exit, SPY comparison and corporate-action/fee treatment. News containing same-day observed price moves may be used only for later targets, never to explain/predict a move already observed in the input. StockBench benchmark-relative assessment still needs independently verified continuous SPY prices; three of four sampled SPY daily paths were absent.
decision.china_comparison: Parent TraderHarness audit reports much broader continuous prices, prior financial facts and announcement coverage, but mostly headlines/redactions and 83.9% midnight announcement precision. Prefer that corpus for disclosure-driven Chinese-market reasoning if conservative next-session availability and execution conventions are explicit. StockBench is the clearer small US alternative with precise publication clocks and modest news text; it is not equally broad or a verified full disclosure corpus.

actual_records.audit: All122 civil dates 2025-03-01 through2025-06-30, hard64KiB/file bound; no historical provider refetch.70 nonempty files,52 HTTP404 files treated unknown,266 unique IDs and URLs.
actual_records.published_utc_naive_offset_bug: All249 Finnhub naive published_utc values equal native UTC epoch plus8hours. FinnhubClient uses datetime.fromtimestamp without timezone. Use epoch with timezone.utc; never interpret the naive field as UTC.
actual_records.text: 256 nonempty descriptions of266; median177characters, maximum764. Headlines/descriptions, not full articles. Sources include Yahoo, SeekingAlpha, MarketWatch, DowJones and Finnhub. No explicit mock/dummy/synthetic-news markers found; marker absence does not prove authenticity.
actual_records.matched_price: Four predetermined monthly AAPL daily parquet files decoded: March3,April1,May1,June2. March3 open241.79/high244.0272/low236.112/close238.03/volume47183985/vwap239.9029. SPY March3 decoded; SPY April1/May1/June2 paths returned404. Thus continuous market-relative price support is NOT established.

candidates.construction_and_leakage: Two raw record schemas: Polygon original publisher/URL/tickers/published_utc and Finnhub title/description/native epoch/API IDs. Drop Polygon insights/sentiment and current fundamental caches. No updated_at, ingestion_at or body-version history in inspected records. Cache date is an organization/decision key, not source availability. Missing files do not establish no-news days; this is a sparse curated snapshot, not a complete continuous feed.
candidates.price_basis: OHLCV/vwap, date; decoded artifact lacks an adjustment flag. Polygon adapter exposes adjusted query parameter; establish collection setting and actions before economic returns. Do not mix adjusted close with unrelated opens or infer total-return treatment.
candidates.rights: Repository Apache2.0 code license does not establish rights to redistribute Finnhub/Polygon/publisher news or prices. Keep samples private; resolve provider/source usage terms before redistributing raw payloads.
candidates.quality: Best inspected small US replay input, conditionally admissible with raw-clock reconstruction and explicit snapshot assumptions; no claim of contamination-free historical outcomes.

actual_records.original_AA_news: 262144-byte prefix preserves Date/Url/Text/Mark, including January17,2024 08:52am EST; original time converts13:52UTC. News also has Jan16 after-close17:51EST/17:24EST.
actual_records.matched_AA_price: Pinned raw price tail contains Jan17/18/19 OHLCV. Jan18 open27.6200008392334/close26.75. First raw price records1970 include distinct Close and AdjClose; basis cannot be silently merged.
actual_records.HF_prefix: 44 complete leading records of A company,43 midnightUTC and1 intraday/hour timestamp, from2023Sep–Dec. This bound does not measure full AAPL or monthly corpus coverage.

candidates.construction_and_leakage: preprocess.py adds -5EST/-4EDT to local time to produce UTC, reversing the required conversion. price_news_integrate normalizes dates to midnight before same-day sentiment merge, collapsing after-close availability. Processed/merged tables and summaries are not accepted prediction inputs. Reconstruct from original timezone-labelled strings; day-only rows use explicit conservative delay. Current scrape/body snapshots lack initial-versus-updated content history.
candidates.rights: CC BY-NC4.0 LICENSE plus README prohibition of commercial code use; underlying Nasdaq/Benzinga/other publisher rights separate. Research inspection does not grant redistribution.
candidates.quality: Larger longitudinal acquisition lead, not selected on a claimed continuous dataset span. Needs per-ticker/month coverage audit and raw-clock recovery first; huge HF files were not downloaded.

actual_records.raw_AAPL_tweets: Pinned2014Jan1/2/3 files contain8/33/21 records with Twitter created_at including explicit +0000 timezone, original IDs/text. Files contain whole-day streams; filter exact tweet timestamp before issue.
actual_records.coverage_boundary: Counts are directory metadata of nonempty files, not proof that every body is usable. Three actual files parsed, no entire corpus scan.
actual_records.prices: Existing rawAAPL CSV has Date/Open/High/Low/Close/AdjClose/Volume; sample2012Sep4 Open95.108574/Close96.424286/AdjClose87.121140.

candidates.construction_and_leakage: Use raw tweets and raw prices only. Strip engagement/favorite/retweet counts and current user attributes because their snapshot availability is not the original tweet time. Original normalized movement labels and same-day full tweet bags are not the new decision target. Strong model historical exposure risk.
candidates.rights: Dataset/code MIT notices do not independently grant social-post redistribution rights. Treat as social-information control, not a full financial-news corpus.
candidates.quality: Timestamped matched baseline; weaker substantive financial context than genuine filings/news.

other_sources_checked.facts: Existing local annex reused; pipeline README explicitly separates partly private Refinitiv and Alpaca acquisition from Fake-Sample-Data.zip. Official real input folders contain gitkeep files, not inspected real news. Alpaca pipeline strips Z from created_at and groups by an ad-hoc date/09:00 transformation; later pipeline uses adjusted closes and date-level news/filings. No execution/pickle loading.
other_sources_checked.decision: Architecture/construction prior art, not a verified public matched corpus.

other_sources_checked.decision: Requires an explicit source acquisition/vintage audit; paper results do not supply a PIT record contract.

other_sources_checked.decision: Task/QA/forecast evaluation prior art; no assumption of usable historical-news corpus from benchmark branding.

validation_and_boundary.claim: Inspection establishes recorded bytes and declared construction only; no completeness, publisher-vintage certification, profitability or model-contamination immunity.
